documents.title: Subscription Cancellation Policy
documents.summary: Covers the end-to-end cancellation flow for all plan tiers. Describes immediate vs. end-of-period cancellation modes, confirmation email generation, data retention post-cancellation, and the conditions under which a cancellation is considered effective. Includes tier-specific provisions for Starter, Growth, and Professional plans.

documents.title: Billing Cycles and Invoice Generation
documents.summary: Defines the monthly billing cycle mechanics: anchor date, proration logic, invoice generation window (T-3 days), charge posting date, and the relationship between subscription state changes and upcoming invoice suppression. Explains when a charge that has already been queued can or cannot be recalled.

documents.title: Refund Eligibility Matrix
documents.summary: Matrix table mapping refund eligibility to plan tier, time since charge, cancellation status, and whether the charge was post-cancellation or overlapping. Includes columns for full refund, partial refund, credit-only, and no-refund outcomes. References grace_period_policy for PRO and Enterprise tier rows.

documents.title: Professional Plan — Cancellation Terms and Obligations
documents.summary: Plan-specific addendum to the general cancellation policy for Professional-tier accounts. Details the 7-day grace period post-effective-cancellation during which charges generated in the billing queue may be reversed, minimum notice requirements, any outstanding commitment obligations, and the procedure for confirming cancellation has propagated to the billing engine.

documents.title: Grace Period Policy for Post-Cancellation Charges
documents.summary: Defines the grace period mechanism: any charge that posts within 7 calendar days of a confirmed cancellation effective date is categorised as a grace-period charge and is automatically eligible for full refund. Specifies verification steps, the refund initiation API endpoint (POST /billing/refunds), required request fields, and expected settlement timeline (3-5 business days).

documents.title: Billing Dispute Handling Procedures
documents.summary: Step-by-step agent workflow for handling customer-reported billing disputes. Covers verification of cancellation records, cross-referencing charge dates against cancellation confirmations, initiating refunds via the billing API, communicating resolution timelines to customers, and escalation path if the billing system cannot be updated within 24 hours.

documents.title: Refund Processing Timelines by Payment Method
documents.summary: Specifies expected settlement durations for refunds by payment method: credit card (3-5 business days), ACH/bank transfer (5-7 business days), PayPal (1-3 business days), and cryptocurrency (non-refundable, credit only). Includes guidance on what to communicate to customers while the refund is in-flight.

documents.title: Account Status Definitions and State Transitions
documents.summary: Authoritative reference for all account states: Active, Cancelled, Suspended, Delinquent, Reactivated, and Pending Deletion. Describes valid transitions between states, what triggers each transition, and how account state affects billing, API access, data availability, and support eligibility.

documents.title: Invoice Suppression and Charge Recall Rules
documents.summary: Technical policy on when invoices can be suppressed before posting and when charges can be recalled after posting. A cancellation received more than 3 days before the next billing anchor suppresses the invoice; a cancellation received within 3 days cannot suppress a queued charge but may trigger grace-period eligibility.

documents.title: Professional Plan Feature Overview
documents.summary: Marketing and support reference for the Professional plan: included feature set, usage limits, API rate limits, SLA commitments, and comparison with Starter and Growth plans. Does not cover billing or cancellation terms.

documents.title: Customer Data Retention After Cancellation
documents.summary: Describes how long customer data is retained post-cancellation: 90 days for account data, 30 days for session logs, 7 years for billing records (regulatory requirement). Covers data export options and the permanent deletion request process.

documents.title: Terms of Service — Version 4.1 (Effective June 2024)
documents.summary: Master terms of service governing all plan tiers. Sections relevant to billing disputes include §7 (Payment and Billing), §8 (Cancellation and Termination), §9 (Refunds), and §12 (Dispute Resolution). References applicable consumer protection laws and arbitration clause.

documents.title: Responding to Credit Card Chargebacks and Disputes
documents.summary: Internal playbook for handling chargeback notices from payment processors. Covers evidence packages, response deadlines, and how proactive refunds affect chargeback outcomes. Notes that issuing a refund before a chargeback is filed significantly improves dispute resolution rate.

documents.title: Goodwill Credits and Service Recovery
documents.summary: Policy for issuing account credits as goodwill gestures: eligibility criteria, maximum credit amounts by account tier, approval requirements for credits above $50, and the credit issuance API endpoint. Intended for cases where a full refund is not warranted but customer retention is a priority.

documents.title: Subscription Reactivation Policy
documents.summary: Covers the conditions and process for reactivating a cancelled subscription: reactivation window (90 days post-cancellation), data restoration, billing anchor reset, any promotional offers available to returning customers, and impact on prior cancellation refund eligibility if the account is reactivated.

documents.title: Prorated Billing Guide for Mid-Cycle Changes
documents.summary: Explains how charges are calculated when a subscription is upgraded, downgraded, or cancelled mid-cycle. Includes the proration formula, examples for common scenarios, and how proration interacts with annual prepaid plans. Not applicable to post-cancellation charges.

documents.title: Starter Plan — Cancellation Terms
documents.summary: Cancellation terms specific to the Starter tier: no grace period, refunds available only within 24 hours of charge, cancellations are effective immediately with no end-of-period option.

documents.title: Growth Plan — Cancellation Terms
documents.summary: Cancellation terms for the Growth tier: 3-day grace period, end-of-period cancellation default, partial refund available if cancellation is within the first 7 days of a new billing period.

documents.title: Enterprise Plan — Cancellation Terms and SLA
documents.summary: Enterprise-specific cancellation: 30-day notice requirement, dedicated account manager involvement, custom refund terms per contract, and SLA credits applied before any monetary refund.

documents.title: Updating Payment Methods and Billing Information
documents.summary: How customers can update their credit card, bank account, or billing address. Covers failed payment retry logic, dunning sequence, and what happens to a scheduled charge if a payment method is updated within 24 hours of the charge date.

documents.title: Failed Payment Recovery and Account Suspension
documents.summary: Describes the dunning sequence: first retry at T+3 days, second at T+7, account suspension at T+14, cancellation at T+30. Includes customer notification templates and the reinstatement process after payment recovery.

documents.title: Support Ticket SLA and Response Time Commitments
documents.summary: Defines first-response and resolution SLAs by plan tier: Starter (48h / 5 business days), Growth (24h / 3 business days), Professional (4h / 1 business day), Enterprise (1h / same business day). Includes escalation triggers.

documents.title: API Usage-Based Billing Addendum
documents.summary: Supplemental billing terms for customers on usage-based API pricing. Covers metering intervals, overage charges, usage caps, and how usage charges interact with base subscription cancellations. Not applicable to flat-rate subscription plans.

documents.title: Tax, VAT, and Regional Billing Compliance
documents.summary: Covers sales tax and VAT collection, exemption certificates, regional billing compliance (EU VAT, US state tax), and how tax amounts are handled in refund scenarios (tax portion refunded separately in some jurisdictions).

documents.title: Annual Prepaid Plan — Refund and Cancellation Policy
documents.summary: Specific refund rules for annual prepaid subscriptions: pro-rated refund for unused months (minus any promotional discount received), non-refundable setup fees, and the 30-day full-refund window from annual plan start date.

documents.title: Professional Plan Onboarding Guide
documents.summary: Step-by-step onboarding checklist for new Professional plan customers: workspace setup, team member invitations, integration configuration, and initial API key generation. No billing or cancellation content.

documents.title: Salesforce CRM Integration Guide
documents.summary: Technical documentation for the Salesforce integration: OAuth setup, field mapping, sync frequency, and troubleshooting common sync errors. Includes guidance on surfacing billing status fields in Salesforce opportunity records.

documents.title: Handling GDPR Data Subject Requests
documents.summary: Procedures for responding to GDPR data subject requests: right of access (30-day response), right to erasure, right to portability, and data processing records. Includes escalation to DPO for complex requests. Not billing-related.

documents.title: Password Reset, MFA, and Account Recovery
documents.summary: Instructions for customers and agents on resetting passwords, enabling and recovering MFA, and restoring account access after lockout. Covers verification requirements for account recovery on cancelled accounts.

documents.title: How to Submit a Feature Request
documents.summary: Customer-facing guide on submitting feature requests via the product portal, voting on existing requests, and understanding the product roadmap communication process. No billing or account management content.
